market.icp: Privacy-conscious meeting participants who need local-first notes
market.buyerPain: A participant can delete meetings one at a time but cannot intentionally reset the full local library, and a filtered view can hide the true destructive scope.
market.revenueHypothesis: A clearly scoped, count-aware library reset makes the local-first product easier to reuse for demos, pilots, and privacy-sensitive workflows.

increment.name: clear-library-confirmation
acceptanceCriteria: A non-empty meeting library shows one Clear all meetings action beside the existing library summary.
An empty library does not show the destructive action.
The native confirmation states the total local meeting count, including meetings hidden by filters, with correct singular and plural copy.
Cancelling confirmation preserves the library; confirming clears meetings, the active note, search text, and the Open actions filter.
The increment changes no empty-state copy, CSS, dependency, account, provider, storage schema, billing, or deployment configuration.
The focused clear-library contract, all local contracts, TypeScript, and production build pass locally.
LICENSE, dependency manifests, credentials, providers, billing, and deployment configuration remain unchanged.

delivery.checker: Codex separate local verification; independent checker unavailable in this bounded single-agent slice
delivery.rollback: Revert only the clear-library confirmation commit on feat/sidenote-clear-library.
delivery.stopCondition: Stop after one verified clear-library increment; do not merge, deploy, submit to an app store, spend, change credentials, or change licensing.
